title: What makes a harness a harness: necessary and sufficient conditions for an agent harness
title_zh: 什么使 Harness 成为 Harness：Agent Harness 的必要与充分条件
abstract_en: The term agent harness now circulates widely in software engineering with generative artificial intelligence. It names the layer that wraps a language model and turns it into a coding agent able to act on a repository. The usage is loose and polysemous. Sometimes the term denotes the whole product (Claude Code, Codex CLI); sometimes it denotes the evaluation scaffold that runs an agent against tasks (the SWE-bench harness); sometimes it gets conflated with an agent framework, an SDK, an IDE plugin, or an orchestrator. What is missing is a reference definition that works as an instrument, one that includes and excludes cases consistently. We build that definition through a conceptual analysis that combines works with persistent identifiers and primary grey-literature sources, such as official documentation, glossaries, and engineering reports. We reconstruct the genealogy of the term, from the horse's tack to the classic test harness, to the machine-learning evaluation harness, and finally to the agent harness. We then propose a constitutive definition that states the necessary and sufficient conditions for a system to be an agent harness, we operationalize it as an inclusion and exclusion test, and we draw the boundary of the concept against an agent framework, an agent SDK, an IDE plugin, an eval harness, and an orchestrator. We apply the definition to six real harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Aider, Cline, OpenHands, and SWE-agent) and to deliberate edge cases; the test includes and excludes consistently. We close with a research agenda organized by design tension axes. The contribution is an operational definition of agent harness, with a shared vocabulary, able to guide engineering practice and the scientific comparison of agentic systems.
abstract_zh: 本文针对生成式 AI 软件工程中被广泛但含义混杂使用的术语“agent harness”提出一个可操作的参考定义。作者指出，该术语有时指完整产品，如 Claude Code、Codex CLI；有时指评测脚手架，如 SWE-bench harness；也常与 agent framework、SDK、IDE plugin 或 orchestrator 混用。论文通过概念分析，结合带持久标识符的学术工作与官方文档、术语表、工程报告等灰色文献，梳理了 harness 一词从马具、经典 test harness、机器学习 evaluation harness 到 agent harness 的演化脉络。随后，论文提出 agent harness 的构成性定义，给出判定系统是否属于 agent harness 的必要与充分条件，并将其操作化为包含/排除测试。作者进一步划清 agent harness 与 agent framework、agent SDK、IDE plugin、eval harness、orchestrator 的边界，并将定义应用于 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Aider、Cline、OpenHands、SWE-agent 六个真实系统及若干边界案例，验证其一致性。最后，论文提出围绕设计张力轴展开的研究议程，旨在为 agentic systems 的工程实践与科学比较提供共享词汇和可执行分类标准。
key_points_zh: 论文核心贡献是为 agent harness 提出必要与充分条件，而不是仅给出松散描述，使该概念可用于一致的包含与排除判断。
作者通过概念谱系分析追溯 harness 从马具、test harness、ML evaluation harness 到 agent harness 的语义演化。
论文明确区分 agent harness 与 agent framework、agent SDK、IDE plugin、eval harness、orchestrator，减少术语混淆。
定义被应用到 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Aider、Cline、OpenHands、SWE-agent 等真实系统，并覆盖有意设计的边界案例。
论文面向软件工程与 AI agent 研究，强调共享词汇对工程实践、系统比较和未来研究议程的重要性。

llm_assessment.comment: Useful conceptual clarification for the agent-harness field, but it contributes vocabulary and boundaries rather than executable infrastructure or improvement loops.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该文对智能体 harness 概念边界有帮助，但主要贡献是术语和分类，而非可执行基础设施或自改进闭环。
